definitions.explanation: A formal/literary honorific prefix, more elevated than お or ご.

examples.japanese: ⟦{御礼|おんれい}→御礼：noentry⟧⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧。
⟦{御社|おんしゃ}→御社：17179_onsha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ご→ご：09882_go⟧⟦{発展|はってん}→発展：03561_hatten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お→お：03097_o⟧⟦{祈|いの}りします→祈る：01198_inoru⟧。
examples.english: I wish for your company's prosperity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{御身|おんみ}→御身：noentry⟧⟦お→お：03097_o⟧⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧。

notes:
{御|おん}〜 is a formal/literary honorific prefix, more elevated than お〜 or ご〜.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{御礼|おんれい}→御礼：noentry⟧: gratitude, thanks (formal)
- ⟦{御社|おんしゃ}→御社：17179_onsha⟧: your company (in business correspondence)
- ⟦{御中|おんちゅう}→御中：17085_onchuu⟧: used when addressing organizations in letters
- ⟦{御名|おんな}→御名：noentry⟧: your name (archaic/formal)

USAGE:
This prefix is quite formal and often appears in:
- Business correspondence
- Formal documents
- Historical/literary texts
- Religious contexts

COMPARISON OF HONORIFIC PREFIXES:
- ⟦お〜→お〜：03097_o⟧: standard polite (⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧)
- ⟦ご〜→ご〜：09882_go⟧: polite for Sino-Japanese (⟦ご→ご〜：09882_go⟧⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧)
- {御|おん}〜: formal/literary (⟦{御礼|おんれい}→御礼：noentry⟧)
